code = '''import hashlib
import hmac
import base64


def verify_webhook(raw_body: bytes, hmac_header: str | None, secret: str) -> bool:
    if not hmac_header:
        return False
    try:
        hmac_header.encode("ascii")
    except UnicodeEncodeError:
        return False

    digest = hmac.new(secret.encode("utf-8"), raw_body, hashlib.sha256).digest()
    expected = base64.b64encode(digest).decode("ascii")

    return hmac.compare_digest(hmac_header, expected)
'''
with open('/work/shopify_webhook.py', 'w') as f:
    f.write(code)

import subprocess, sys, textwrap

test_script = '''
import sys, os, io, importlib, hashlib, hmac, base64

sys.path.insert(0, "/work")

# Check no side effects on import: capture stdout
buf = io.StringIO()
old_stdout = sys.stdout
sys.stdout = buf
import shopify_webhook
sys.stdout = old_stdout
assert buf.getvalue() == "", f"Import produced output: {buf.getvalue()!r}"

from shopify_webhook import verify_webhook

secret = "my_secret_key"
body = b'{"id":123,"name":"#1001"}'

digest = hmac.new(secret.encode("utf-8"), body, hashlib.sha256).digest()
valid_header = base64.b64encode(digest).decode("ascii")

# Valid case
assert verify_webhook(body, valid_header, secret) is True

# Wrong secret
assert verify_webhook(body, valid_header, "wrong_secret") is False

# Wrong body
assert verify_webhook(b"different body", valid_header, secret) is False

# None header
assert verify_webhook(body, None, secret) is False

# Empty header
assert verify_webhook(body, "", secret) is False

# Non-ASCII header
assert verify_webhook(body, "cafÃ©" + valid_header, secret) is False

# Truncated/garbage header
assert verify_webhook(body, valid_header[:-1], secret) is False

# Different body bytes but same content differently encoded (e.g. trailing newline)
body2 = body + b"\\n"
digest2 = hmac.new(secret.encode("utf-8"), body2, hashlib.sha256).digest()
valid_header2 = base64.b64encode(digest2).decode("ascii")
assert verify_webhook(body2, valid_header, secret) is False
assert verify_webhook(body2, valid_header2, secret) is True

# Unicode secret
secret_u = "sÃ«cret-Ã¼"
digest3 = hmac.new(secret_u.encode("utf-8"), body, hashlib.sha256).digest()
valid_header3 = base64.b64encode(digest3).decode("ascii")
assert verify_webhook(body, valid_header3, secret_u) is True

print("ALL TESTS PASSED")
'''

with open('/work/test_shopify_webhook.py', 'w') as f:
    f.write(test_script)

result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '/work/test_shopify_webhook.py'], capture_output=True, text=True)
